# Disagreement Log — GTH_059

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 59
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 59 | "Look upon" | "Look upon" | "Gaze upon" | Intensity of visual verb |
| 2 | 59 | "so that you will not die" | "lest you die" | "otherwise you will die" | Purpose/warning clause rendering |
| 3 | 59 | "be unable to see" | "be unable" | "find you cannot" | Final clause — ellipsis vs. expanded |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts LOGOS's "lest" for the warning clause and "be unable" for the final ellipsis; "Look upon" (EMET/LOGOS) over PNEUMA's "Gaze upon."
